h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kolkata

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kolkata

c: Kolkata's morning walkers already fill the city's lakes, maidans and neighbourhood parks, so an open-air gym rarely stands idle here. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kolkata for the municipal corporation, housing complexes, schools and clubs. We manufacture every Fun Fitness machine at our Vasai factory, about 1640 km away, and bring it to the city by road for installation.

Most enquiries come from three kinds of site. Housing complexes in New Town and Salt Lake want a compact set beside their walking track. Neighbourhood clubs and parks need sturdy machines that can take crowds, and schools ask for stations that teenagers and staff can share. In each case we start with the ground. Kolkata waterlogs quickly in the monsoon, so we mark a raised, well-drained base on the layout.

items.q: Does FunPlay supply open gym equipment to municipal parks in Kolkata?
items.a: Yes. We supply parks, housing complexes, schools and clubs. Send us the site size and photos, and we will return a layout drawing and a quote that your committee or department can review.

items.q: How do I keep an outdoor gym in good order through the monsoon?
items.a: Check the bolts and moving parts once the heavy rain ends, clear standing water around the footings and wipe down the handles. We share a simple maintenance routine when the machines are handed over.

items.q: Can you install machines inside a housing complex in New Town or Salt Lake?
items.a: Yes. We plan around the space you have, whether it is a podium, a lawn or a strip along the boundary wall, and mark clear space around each station on the drawing.
